comment: Read from the source at tag v2.1.14 (commit 75e5f70), which is the installed build. The module declares no parameters, inputs or outputs, so it has no tags and no props; all of its behaviour is on the button it inserts into Rack's menu bar (nightbin.cpp:500-512), and the menu lines say so. The module sends HTTP requests to api.github.com on a background thread as soon as it is placed and whenever a query is asked for (nightbin.cpp:77, 306). The token the user types is stored unencrypted in questionablemodules.json under gitPersonalAccessToken (nightbin.cpp:361); no token value appears anywhere in this entry.
